# Getting help

- **A record is wrong or out of date:** use "Report a correction" on the record's page, or open a
  *Policy data correction* issue. Every report is decided and logged at
  [aipolicytracker.org/corrections](https://aipolicytracker.org/corrections).
- **A law or jurisdiction is missing:** open a *New jurisdiction or source* issue with the official source.
- **The site or the code misbehaves:** open a *Bug report* with the address and what you expected.
- **Using the data or the API:** start with the [open data and API page](https://aipolicytracker.org/open-data) (machine-readable spec at `/openapi.json`) and
  [`data/README.md`](../data/README.md). Ask anything else by e-mail: bhaskar@aipolicytracker.org.
- **A security problem:** do not open an issue; follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Nothing here is legal advice, and the maintainer cannot say whether a law applies to your organisation.
